notes.title: 1.1.4 Patch - Control
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! 

In search of the best control setting, I came to the banal conclusion that I need to give players the ability to change the control keys.
Now, you can assign any key on the keyboard, while on the gamepad, due to technical features, had to add only types of controls. 

If none of the types of controls on the gamepad are right for you, feel free to suggest your own variants. It is very likely that I will add them in the next update. 

A more detailed list of changes and fixes can be found below. Thank you for your attention. 

[i]Regards, Mikhail[/i]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list][*] Added the ability to change the control keys for the keyboard, as well as types of control for the gamepad.
[*] Added delay before the second phase of the second boss attack.
[*] Added shot damage to the second boss of the game when he is stunned.
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where the sound in the in-game menu was looped.
[*] Fixed bug where Xbox One's gamepad didn't work properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the protagonist, when standing close to the spikes, was damaged when he turned.
[*] Fixed bug where the game did not memorize what boxes with skins were open and they had to open again.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game loaded an interrupted session with the language at the time of saving, not the one selected at the beginning of the game.
[*] Fixed some locations.
[*] Fixed spikes animation.
[*] Fixed "traps" in the second location, now they are easier to see.
[*] Fixed the achievement of the "Sharp Shooter", now it is easier to get it.
[*] Fixed the first boss's hit box, now it's easier to hit it.
[*] Fixed the dialog system, now the buttons are more noticeable, and also added a small pause before they appear, in order not to accidentally miss a part of the dialog.
[*] Fully rewritten the behavior of fragile blocks, now it works more traditionally.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.3 Patch now done
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! 

Patch 1.1.3 is ready! I hope that bugs and shortcomings have not ruined the impression of the game!

[b]Change log:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed minor bugs with skins.
[*] Fixed bug where music continued to play after credits.
[*] Fixed bug where items were glued to spikes.
[*] Fixed bug where items were rolled under bosses.
[*] Fixed bug where the count of destroyed bushes, gravestones, skulls, gold chests could work one unit earlier than it should.
[*] Fixed bug where the game did not remember the last dressed skin.
[*] Fixed bug where the clock chimes was not going well.
[*] Fixed lava behavior. Now it only slows down, but does not limit the height of the jump.
[*] Fixed the behavior of Grace Igoryan. Now, after the rebirth, Igor's Grace restores all the ammunition.
[*] Fixed the level-design of some locations to improve the understanding of the hidden mechanics of the game.
[*] Fixed bomb behavior. Now they damage everyone, not just the player.
[*] Added gamepad vibration when the appropriate option is enabled.
[*] Added the function to continue the interrupted game.
[*] Added the function of replenishing your health by sitting in a chair.
[*] Added the function to skip the fade in or fade out of death.
[*] Added an additional indicator for the interface, indicating that there is the necessary amount of pizza to refill your health.
[*] Optimized calculation of the destroyed enemies, objects and chests.
[*] The jumping system has been completely reworked. Namely: the coyote time is longer; the buffering of jumps is added; the height of the jump depends on the time of pressing the jump button.
[*] The possibility of a simultaneous jump shot is removed. As it turned out, this confuses players more than makes it easier to play.
[*] Removed the ability to enable or disable full-screen mode by pressing a key.[/list]
Thank you all for your patience and your bug reports.

[i]Regards, Mikhail[/i]
